title: KGLO 1490: An Eerie Dialogue-Driven Text Adventure
author: Metapharstic
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/p59qz8d77jwh1.png

There are so many amazing projects on here lately that I'm a little nervous about posting this. My game's a lot smaller in scale, but I think it's intriguing nonetheless.

**KGLO 1490** is a mysterious dialogue-driven text adventure game set during the overnight shift of a small-town radio station. You're a lonely DJ tasked with answering calls and chatting with the locals about whatever's on their minds. Turns out, there's a lot of dark stuff happening behind closed doors, and folks are ready to talk about it.

Help callers through their dilemmas; your choices have consequences. Remember that a failed call may unlock a story branch you wouldn't have encountered otherwise.

The story unfolds over several nights. With over 200 strange callers, a cache of records to spin, and dozens of community and news bulletins to read to the world, there's always something to keep your listeners entertained. Assuming they're not battling their own demons.

Check it out over at Itch.io: [KGLO 1490](https://metapharstic.itch.io/kglo-1490)
